note: Upper bounds of work per script, recorded from the implementation. The identity fix (plans/identity-plan.md) tightened the table again and is the reason the value is now the recorded one: an in-place re-spelling keeps every token and node id, so those scripts add no identity and invalidate fewer units. content_commits counts whole-content values that were actually published, one per field a write group really moved. The declared-tree work removed the per-node field map, which nothing read: meta_units_written fell by one unit pair per published field and the bounds were re-recorded.
